decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that captures the exact one-to-one overlay match requirement; adding another MODIFY would duplicate the same semantic change.
The exact overlay rule applies to the É accent and Hero V terminal, not to the lowercase v. The separate lowercase-v reach change from the same message is already represented by its own MODIFY.
The approved Hero V terminal serves as the fixed comparison source for the accent overlay; the decision does not change the Hero V geometry itself.
The overlay rule concerns the É accent, not the construction of the supporting E and L letterforms.
Exact geometric matching between the É accent and Hero V terminal does not alter the closing V's relative size or visual subordination.
The vector-overlay evaluation rule does not change the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The accent-terminal overlay requirement does not change the deferred full-wordmark kerning goal.
The optional request for a construction diagram supports evaluation of the accent derivation but does not modify the standing requirement to explain the design intention of each review round.
